plan.focus: Find useful space after you pass.
plan.why: Give a driving teammate room and stay available for the next pass.
plan.successStandard: Explain what you noticed and choose an action that fits the team’s spacing.

practice.title: Pass, Look, Decide

steps.title: Pass
steps.cue: Make the pass, then get your eyes back to the play.

steps.title: Look
steps.cue: See where your teammate is going and where help is standing.

steps.title: Decide
steps.cue: Cut when the lane and your spacing allow it. If your teammate drives, give them room and stay available.

practice.reflectionPrompt: What did you notice about the lane, and what did you choose to do?

sampleCoachResponse.label: Sample Coach Response · Coach Keith
sampleCoachResponse.text: You saw the drive and gave your teammate space. Next time, look again when the driver stops or passes out.
sampleCoachResponse.nextAdjustment: Walk through two reps. Say what changed in the lane before deciding whether to move.
